title: Nike Stock: Buy, Hold, or Sell? (My Final Verdict) | NKE Stock Deep Dive Part 5
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble numbers in places. Video was members-only in earlier runs and went public before this run; captions were fetched on a manual retry in this run after scan.py reported caption_ok:false (playability OK). Final part of the 5-part Nike deep dive (Parts 1-4 were UNCERTAIN, verdict deferred to Part 5).
summary: Part 5 final verdict on Nike: management guides FY27 revenue down high single digits (-7/8/9%) with pressure worsening through the year and into FY28 - the opposite of the improving trend Parkevtate had modelled (-4/5/6% in Q1 improving to flat/+1-2% by Q4); operating income likely -15 to -20%. Stock -46% YTD in 2026. He recounts warning against buying all year, upgrading around $40, and now cutting fair value again to $26.60 vs the $35 market price (forward P/E 20, cheapest in years, but competitive position arguably the worst in decades). Verdict: not a buying opportunity now, not interested anywhere near $35 - more interested closer to $25 or on improved performance, and he does not want to be long while Nike figures it out. Recorded as HOLD (reiterating his 2026-10-02 HOLD at FV $29) - no flip.

calls.base_case: Revenue -7 to -9% in FY27 with later quarters worse; profits fall by a larger percentage than revenue.
calls.bull_case: None given in this part; interest only closer to $25 or once performance actually improves.
calls.bear_case: Management may guide FY28 as another down year; competitive position arguably the worst in decades, forward P/E 20 is cheapest in years for a reason.
